declarations.funding: No external funding was received for this research.
declarations.competing_interests: The authors declare no competing financial or non-financial interests relevant to the content of this article.
declarations.ethics_approval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants or animals.
declarations.data_availability: Source code and configuration files for this study are archived at Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21850809; concept DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21850609) and mirrored at https://github.com/yeanSinizter/Thesis. The public deposit is code-only (no manuscript files and no frozen run outputs). Aggregate statistics reported in this article can be regenerated from the packaged scripts under the documented toolchain.
declarations.code_availability: Source code, configuration JSON, and regeneration scripts are included in the Zenodo/GitHub code package (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21850809). See README.md in the deposit.
declarations.author_contributions: Wasawat Buengkanjana: conceptualization, methodology, software, formal analysis, investigation, data curation, writing—original draft, visualization, project administration. Khamron Sunat: supervision, methodology review, writing—review and editing, project administration. Sirapat Chiewchanwattana: supervision, methodology review, writing—review and editing.
declarations.prior_publication: An earlier version of the six-task factorial design appeared in an unpublished MSc thesis (Khon Kaen University, 2026). The journal manuscript adds the placebo-feedback ladder, Q1 task extensions, dynamic-validation audits, and frozen replication artifacts not present in that thesis.
declarations.llm_disclosure: Locally hosted code LLMs (Ollama) were used as experimental subjects only, not as manuscript authors. No generative AI was used for autonomous content creation.

acknowledgment: The authors thank colleagues and reviewers for feedback on measurement design, placebo controls, and construct-validity audits. Compute was performed on local workstations using Ollama; no external grant funded this replication export.
